scene=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.CreateScene("ImpactAudioIsolatedPhysics",new UnityEngine.SceneManagement.CreateSceneParameters(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.LocalPhysicsMode.Physics2D));try{var ground=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Test ground");ground.layer=UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer("Collider");var gc=ground.AddComponent<UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D>();gc.size=new UnityEngine.Vector2(100,1);UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(ground,scene);var physics=scene.GetPhysicsScene2D();for(int test=0;test<2;test++){var probe=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Test hammer");probe.layer=UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer("Character");probe.transform.position=new UnityEngine.Vector3(0,.8f,0);var collider=probe.AddComponent<UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D>();collider.size=UnityEngine.Vector2.one*.2f;var body=probe.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>();body.gravityScale=0;body.constraints=UnityEngine.RigidbodyConstraints2D.FreezeRotation;body.collisionDetectionMode=UnityEngine.CollisionDetectionMode2D.Continuous;probe.AddComponent<Character.ContactSoundEffect>();UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(probe,scene);yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForSecondsRealtime(.3f);var router=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>();int before=router==null?0:router.PlayCount;body.velocity=test==0?new UnityEngine.Vector2(10,-.5f):new UnityEngine.Vector2(0,-4);for(int step=0;step<40;step++)physics.Simulate(.02f);router=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>();int after=router==null?0:router.PlayCount;if(test==0 && after!=before)throw new System.Exception("Light sliding collision played");if(test==1 && (after<=before || !router.LastClipName.StartsWith("footstep_grass_")))throw new System.Exception("Strong physical collision did not play grass");UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(probe);yield return
